name: Electric Assisted Bicycle
description: A device with two or three wheels, a saddle, fully operative pedals and an electric motor of no more than 750 watts, in one of three classes: Class I and Class III pedal-assist up to 20 and 28 mph, and Class II motor-propelled up to 20 mph.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels, a saddle, fully operative pedals, and a motor with a power output of no more than 750 watts (O.C.G.A. §40-1-1(15.3))
Class I assists only while the rider pedals and stops at 20 mph; Class II's motor can propel it alone, up to 20 mph; Class III assists only while pedaling and stops at 28 mph (O.C.G.A. §40-6-300)
Has the equipment required of a bicycle, and must be able to disengage the motor when the rider stops pedaling or applies the brakes (O.C.G.A. §40-6-302)
Class III must have a speedometer showing its speed in miles per hour (O.C.G.A. §40-6-302)

Bikes made since January 1, 2020 carry a permanent label, in at least 9-point Arial, stating the class, motor wattage and top assisted speed; anyone who alters one in a way that changes its class must relabel it (O.C.G.A. §40-6-302)
Class III riders must be 15 or older; a younger passenger may ride on one designed to carry passengers (O.C.G.A. §40-6-303)
Class III riders and passengers must wear a bicycle helmet, and a Class III can't be rented to someone without a helmet (O.C.G.A. §40-6-303)
Riders and passengers under 16 must wear a bicycle helmet on any class, as on a bicycle
Has the rights and duties of a bicycle (O.C.G.A. §40-6-301)
Class I and Class II may use any bicycle or shared-use path bicycles may, unless the local authority or state agency in charge bans them (O.C.G.A. §40-6-303)
Class III is kept off bicycle and shared-use paths unless the path runs within or beside a highway or the local authority or state agency in charge allows it (O.C.G.A. §40-6-303)
On a natural-surface trail designated nonmotorized, the local authority or state agency that manages it decides which devices are allowed (O.C.G.A. §40-6-303)
Excluded from the definitions of motor vehicle and motor driven cycle: no driver's license, registration or insurance
